claim: The EFS FAQ says that, upon sign up, new EFS customers receive 5 GB of Amazon EFS Standard each month for one year under the AWS Free Tier, which is not applicable to files stored in the EFS One Zone file system type; the same FAQ says that starting July 15, 2025, new AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits that can be applied towards eligible services, including Amazon EFS.

qualifiers.scope: new EFS customers, AWS Free Tier; EFS Standard only (not One Zone)
qualifiers.condition: The 5 GB offer is the FAQ's Free Tier wording; new AWS customers from July 15, 2025 receive Free Tier credits

evidence.quote: Upon sign up, new EFS customers receive 5 GB of Amazon EFS Standard each month for one year.
The AWS Free Tier is not applicable to files stored in the EFS One Zone file system type.
Starting July 15, 2025, new AWS customers will receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits, which can be applied towards eligible AWS services, including Amazon Elastic File System.
